title: conyza canadensis var. glabrata
intro: Conyza canadensis var. glabrata, commonly known as Canadian fleabane or smooth horseweed, is a variety of the Conyza canadensis plant, a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Conyza canadensis var. glabrata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
